Bug Fixes

notes.title: Patch 1.1.2
notes.notes:
Changes to Extremely Long, or Never-ending Battles.
- After 25 turns of an Auto battle, battle speed will begin to increase very slightly each turn until the end of the auto battle.
- If 100 turns pass without an enemy minion dying in an auto battle, the battle ends immediately with a duel to the death between leaders. 


Dev note: These changes are not intended to be a balance changes, but are instead intended to prevent rare cases where a battle could literally never end.


Balance Changes
- Quick Attack will no longer activate for Grand Magister Fogg after its text ability attempts to activate, but fails due to the targeted enemy minion already being dead.


Dev note: This interaction wasn't intended and allowed Fogg to force an adjacent minion with Flying and Ranged to attack endlessly. This strategy will still be possible, but the loop will end as soon as the minion next to Fogg attacks and kills a minion itself.


Bug Fixes
- Fixed First Love's "Friendly minions can't damage leaders this battle." clause not working.
- Fixed minions that had Shield removed by Pesticide visually re-gaining Shield when resummoned.
- Fixed incorrect end screen text appearing for Moon victories.
- Potentially fixed Untethered One positions getting mixed up internally after being discarded by Poppit's ability (this is hard to replicate so may not be 100% fixed).

notes.title: Become the Moon Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Become the Moon Update 1.1.0
Hi everyone! This is Ben, the lead designer for Become the Moon and 1/3rd of the Feldspar Games team. Thanks for waiting patiently for this update, I’m hopeful that it will make the experience of playing the game a bit less hostile, and a lot more fun, while still remaining challenging. I included some notes within the patch notes to provide some insight behind why some of the changes were made.
Patch NotesDrafting System Improvements
Whenever you choose a card while drafting, set your reroll cost to (0). Bill was feeling generous and decided to share his ability with everyone!

When you reroll a set of cards, those cards won't appear again for the rest of this draft (unless you run out of cards from their rarity, in which case, all cards of that rarity will be able to appear again)

When you reroll the first set of cards in each draft, their rarity will be preserved (so if your first set of cards in a draft are all legendary, rerolling them will always give 3 different legendaries until you make a selection).

Heavily reduced the chance of Common (Bronze) cards appearing on Tiers 3, 4, 5, 6 and beyond.

Increased the odds of seeing Uncommon (Silver) cards at Tier 3.

Increased the odds of seeing Rare (Gold) cards at Tiers 4, 5, 6, and beyond.

Slightly increased the odds of seeing Legendary (Amethyst) cards at Tiers 4, 5, 6 and beyond.

Your first three cards at Tier 6 and beyond are now guaranteed to be Legendary rarity.



Changes to how Star Cards can be Randomly Generated
Push can no longer be randomly generated.

Bind can only be randomly generated if you haven’t played Bind this round and are not currently holding Bind in your hand.

Garden can no longer be randomly generated.

Tub can only be randomly generated if you haven’t generated Tub this round, aren’t currently holding Tub in hand, and have more than 4 relics currently.

Build, Call, and Lyceum can no longer be chosen by Horoscope. Any other Star Card can, including cards detailed above.

Dev Note: Filling your hand with random star cards is fun, but not if you get bloated with cards you don’t want to play like Push or Bind, so I’ve added some restrictions to ensure that these random cards will almost always be cards you will actually want to play! Also note that Push and Call have both been changed, which is detailed below.



Leader Balance Changes
Pain Killer now reads "Restore [2 -> 3] Health to your leader. If they're still damaged, draw [2 -> 3] cards."

Allison Lycette now reads "All star cards (except Build) lose Destroy this, cost (1) more, and don't Retain."

Nepotism gains "Exhaust this for a round, but cost reduced [1 -> 0]."

Dev Note: The changes to Allison are to prevent infinite combos enabled by Build and Hoard not having Destroy This. Outside of the context of infinite combos, these changes should be a buff to Allison, not a nerf.

 
Card Reworks
Sleeping Death cost reduced [4 -> 2], Health increased [4 -> 6], now reads "Minions and relics that deal damage to random enemy minions deal twice as much damage."

Parting Song now reads "Choose a friendly battle spell to remain in play for an additional round. Draw a card.

Moonlight Enchantress cost reduced [5 -> 4], stats reduced [3/7 -> 2/2], now reads "Minions you summon during battle gain Attack equal to this minion's."

Understudy Sonia stats increased [3/2 -> 5/5], now reads "Shield. Minions you summon during battle gain +5 Attack and Shield." (Effectively, Sonia and Enchantress have swapped abilities!)

Call now reads "Add 2 random Star Cards to your hand. Destroy this."

Push now does what Call used to do, but there's no longer a limit to how many times it can be cast each round.

Wishbone now reads "Start of Round: If you have one or fewer minions in play, double your mana."

Lunar Condenser now reads "When you play a spell that costs (1) or more while your draw pile is empty, get a random Star Card."

Dev Note: The changes to Wishbone and Lunar Condenser are also to prevent infinite combos. These relics should still be very powerful, so hopefully this doesn’t feel like too large of a change. The remaining changes are purely to make the game more fun and strategically diverse. Sleeping Death is the most “out there” change by far and may not be perfect still, but hopefully people will be able to find some fun uses for it!



Card Buffs
Carrion Rose Attack increased [2 -> 3].

Medal Detector Attack increased [1 -> 2].

Middle Manager Health increased [3 -> 4].

Eternity Perfume buff increased [+3/+2 -> +3/+3].

Scry cost reduced [1 -> 0].

Rise to the Occasion Attack buff increased [+2 -> +4].

Angermancer cost reduced [3 -> 2], Health reduced [5 -> 4].

Jar Smasher Health increased [1 -> 3].

Overseer cost reduced [4 -> 3], Attack reduced [3 -> 2].

Show of Force Attack buff increased [+1 -> +2].

Potent Peddler cost reduced [3 -> 2].

Lifedrinker cost reduced [5 -> 4].

Dumpster Diver cost reduced [2 -> 1].

Moonlit Summoner cost reduced [4 -> 3], Attack increased [3 -> 4].

Elusive Owl Health increased [4 -> 5].

Recycle’s mana gain increased [+2 -> +3]."

Deep Breath cost reduced [5 -> 3].

Mimicry cost reduced [4 -> 3].

Battle Symphony cost reduced [5 -> 4].

General Koi cost reduced [6 -> 4], Health reduced [8 -> 6].

Ellipsis Von Battalia stats reduced [5/4 -> 4/3], gains Quick Attack.

Seek Higher Knowledge cost reduced [4 -> 3].

Enfeebling Spores cost reduced [5 -> 4].

Cattle Prod damage reduced [5 -> 3].

Targeting Machine damage increased [7 -> 10].

Mushroom Tea Attack buff increased [+1 -> +2].

Fish no longer requires you to make a choice.

Lyceum no longer requires you to make a choice.



Card Nerfs
Pyramid Scheme gains "Exhaust this for a round."

Dev Note: This is one final change to prevent infinite combos. Pyramid Scheme was probably the most problematic card of all, enabling many different infinites. This felt like the best change to make to prevent infinites without destroying the viability of the card. Technically infinites can still be achieved, but they will require significantly more effort to assemble.



Encounter Balance Changes
Replaced one of the two 2/3 Deathtouch, Shield Toy Soldiers in Porch-2 with a 10/9 Doublestrike, Shield Toy Soldier.

All Porch-3 enemy leader's Attack values reduced [3 -> 2].

All Lyceum-3 enemy leader's Health values reduced [4 -> 3].

Lyceum-3 Lab incidents Attack reduced [7 -> 6], Health reduced [28 -> 25], Lights Out battle spell removed.

Lyceum-3 Slimes Attack increased [10 -> 12].

Moon-1 enemy leader's Attack reduced [3 -> 2].

Moon-2 Lunar Guardians Attack reduced [30 -> 25].

Moon-2 Leader Health reduced [2 -> 1].

Heart of Sonoya and Mouth of Sonoya have had their stats and textboxes swapped.

If an enemy minion has had its abilities removed by Pesticide, its abilities will still be removed when resummoned by Late Spring.

Dev Note: Encounters are by far the easiest thing to change in the game, so if any particular encounter still feels oppressive after this patch, please let the team know in our Discord server or the Steam forums. 



Bug Fixes
Fixed a rare crash caused by having a Grand Magister Fogg with quick attack and one or more minions with Flying and Quick Attack to the right of him.

Fixed Astral Plane wins not being counted after the first win with a leader.

Fixed Taker's Revenge achievement not being rewarded.

Fixed Big Boy and Bigger Boy achievements only having the chance to reward when a card is buffed.

Fixed Startrash and One Man Army achievements losing track of progress after you quitting and continuing a run.

The order of the first 4 leaders you unlock is now fixed even after you unlock the 6th region.

The Retain tooltip now correctly specifies "Round" instead of "Turn."

The leader unlock screen now correctly specifies "Leader" instead of "Character."




For those who want to continue playing on the previous version of the game, there is now a legacy branch in Steam called `legacy-branch` which will contain the previous version of the game from this point onward.

Lastly, I teased “something entirely new” in the last update post, which isn’t present in this update. It still isn’t quite ready yet, but I didn’t want to delay this update any longer, so it’ll be released when it’s ready.

Thanks for playing Become the Moon!

-Ben, and the rest of the Feldspar Games Team

notes.title: Your Feedback & Upcoming Changes
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!


This is Ben, one of the 3 team members at Feldspar Games and Lead Designer on Become the Moon. I’m writing to let you know that we’ve been carefully reading through all of your feedback and we’re currently working on a game update which aims to improve various aspects of the game. I can’t share the full patch notes yet, as the update isn’t quite ready to be released, but I wanted to share some of the areas we will be addressing in this upcoming patch.

Before this though, we’d like to acknowledge your feedback on and apologise for our previous ‘Tips & Tricks’ Steam news post. Early feedback indicated that there were certain areas where people were having the most difficulty with, and the post was aimed at providing some clarity on mechanics which we felt we hadn’t communicated well enough in-game. However, we understand this did not come across as intended, and so we have removed the post. Additionally, with our upcoming changes, many of these mechanics discussed will be reworked based on your feedback.


Rerolling is Too Punishing
The reroll system is really punishing. I designed it like that on purpose to encourage players to be less picky and take cards they wouldn’t otherwise consider if rerolling was cheap, but clearly the current system is just frustrating, which is not the intention.

To address this, we’re looking at making some tweaks to how rerolling works, to give you greater control and agency over how you interact with your drafts, such as decreasing cost per reroll.


The Draft has Too Many Common Cards
We’re also looking at adjusting rarity odds in mid to late tiers to reduce the number of Common (Bronze) cards in the draft and increase the number of Rare (Gold) and Legendary (Amethyst) cards. Another potential solution we’re exploring is starting from tier 6, you’ll be guaranteed to see 3 different Legendary cards in your first set of cards to further ensure that you have a good chance of finding the powerful cards you’re looking for.


Random Star Cards are Bad
Generating random Star Cards should always be a good thing, but more often than not you’ll get stuck with one or more copies of Push or Call which you don’t want to play and clog up your hand.

To address this, we’re experimenting with the following changes:
[olist]
It will no longer be possible to get Push from a random source like Comet Catcher, Star Gazing, etc. This means it will only be obtainable from the reward screen, so you’ll only get it when you actively choose it.

Push will be buffed to only give the enemy leader +1 Health, instead of +1 Health and +1 Attack to make stacking Pushes less risky.

Call is being completely redesigned to be more appealing in any situation. We’ll share what this is when the update is available.


[/olist]Too Many Cards/Builds are Weak in the Late Game
There are a lot of cards that are really fun to play with, but just can’t keep up with 20/20 minions in the late game. This is a pretty big oversight on my part, and I apologize to anyone who’s been trying to win at higher difficulties with Summon builds or On Death builds in particular. It’s possible, but significantly harder and more luck reliant than intended.

We’re currently working on a way to fix this, but aren’t quite ready to share exactly what that is just yet. It will involve some combination of buffing weak cards, nerfing difficult encounters, and something entirely new!


Forced Card Pick
A pure skip option isn’t something that can be added because it will ruin the balance of the tier system, but I’m going to try to see if there’s something that can make not having a skip button feel better for those that really hate not having it. The change to rerolling and the draft odds is one step towards improving this, but there are some other potential changes I’m considering that may make an even bigger difference. I can’t guarantee anything will change with this, but I am certainly going to try to improve the experience for those who really dislike how it currently works.



Of course, many of these solutions are experimental and may be subject to change, however hopefully this gives a bit of insight into how we are looking at addressing the issues you’ve raised.



We really appreciate any and all feedback on Become the Moon, as we are striving to create the best possible experience for all our community. If you have any additional feedback, or if any of your issues aren’t addressed above, please do let us know on our Discord, where you can chat with us directly.



Thank you for reading and for all the support and feedback you’ve shown us so far. We'll keep you posted on any changes as soon as we can.

- Ben

notes.title: Release Date and Steam Next Fest Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!  

We are excited to share that Become the Moon will be fully releasing on June 19th!  

Firstly, thank you for all the feedback from our players and playtesters, your contributions have helped shape and refine the game tremendously. 

Since bringing the game to Steam early last year the game has changed massively: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915025/aad60bd4ccf3bf73ac693554452b9a6d77507cee.png

As you can see above we will also be in the June Steam Next Fest! For this event we’ll be releasing a brand-new demo with a new playable character, more cards, more encounters and a daily challenge mode!  

On the 4th June we’ll also have some additional surprises to share with you here on Steam so please look for that update when it drops next week.  

If you’d like to support the game, consider wishlisting the game and sharing it with a friend or your favourite games creator!

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.6.8
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone that's played the Demo's Lunar New Year update so far! We just pushed a small patch that fixes a few bugs and improves some aspects of the user interface.

UI Improvements
- Cleaned up the game over / victory screen by removing the QR codes and shortening the text.
- Moved rewards slightly down to prevent "Retain" tags from covering text on the reward screen between each combat encounter.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed a broken tutorial message that was showing "undefined" text.
- Fixed player portraits on the character select screen occasionally appearing in the wrong order.

We read every piece of feedback, so please continue reporting bugs and making suggestions in Steam reviews, the Steam community forum, and our discord server.

notes.title: Lunar Demo Update 🌖 New Character, Extended Runs & SC/JP/KR Localisation
notes.notes:
In celebration of Lunar New Year, we’re excited to share our largest demo update yet!

With this new update, we’re rolling out (beta) localisation for Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean! We recognise all the support you’ve already shown us already for BtM, and so we hope this update makes the game even more enjoyable for you!

If you have any feedback for us, please let us know on our Discord or Weibo channels!

Additionally, we’re also unlocking a new playable character – Mercy Burns – able to spend her health directly to play additional cards...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915025/76dd04d5669896f5c203d40212b17b9e85c5e8ae.gif

...as well as a whole new area - The Porch - including 3 additional rounds of new encounters!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915025/a5e85e2f393e03fc15ae425473ac742c0994af74.gif

We hope this update lets you dive deeper into the world of Become the Moon, and meet some more of its inhabitants!

Patch Notes

New Content:

 New Character: Mercy Burns! (Playable after completing one run).
 New Area: The Porch! (Includes 3 additional rounds of new encounters).
 Game Logo on the main menu has been given a makeover!

New Localisations (Beta):

 Simplified Chinese
 Japanese
 Korean

Bug Fixes:

 Cards can no longer have duplicate tooltips
 Ranged, On Death, Quick Attack, and other minion icons now scale more accurately when hovered.

As always, we’d love to hear your thoughts on the latest update over on our Discord & Weibo channels, where you can make suggestions, share runs and get all the latest news on BtM!

Thank you for your continuous feedback – your support helps us shape BtM into the best experience possible for you. We’ll have some more exciting announcements coming in the near future, so make sure to stay tuned!

Feldspar Games 🌠

notes.title: Holiday Demo Update 🎁 Steam Deck & Controller Support 🎮
notes.notes:
With the holiday season in full swing, we’re excited to give you a little gift of our own!  

We’ve updated our demo with (experimental) Steam Deck & controller support, as well as some updates to gameplay which you can check out below! As always, if you have any feedback for us, feel free to drop us a message in our Discord.

Patch Notes:

New Content 

 New Legendary Card: General Nguyen. 
 New Constellation Card: Jail. 
 New encounter added to Tub-3. 
 New encounter added to Garden-2 (replacing an old one). 

Gameplay Changes 

 Reroll cost now starts at 0 each Tier and increases with each use. 

Balance 

 Dormant Ent Health decreased 4 -> 3.
 Dove of Avon Health increased 1 -> 2. 
 Amber Mage Cost decreased 5 -> 4, Health decreased 3 -> 2. 
 Elusive Owl loses Taunt, Health increased 4 -> 6. 
 Amplify Cost decreased 4 -> 3. 
 Mimicry now reads "Your left-most minion copies the stats of the left-most enemy minion and attacks immediately." 
 Ellipsis Von Battalia Cost decreased 5 -> 4. 
 Wing Extensions now reads "Your Flying minions have an additional 20% chance to dodge attacks." 
 Hoard now reads "Draw 3 cards. Destroy this." 
 Garden-3 Serrated Root loses Doublestrike. 

UI Changes 

 The map has been adjusted to make the demo's length less ambiguous. 
 The "You haven't spent all of your Mana" tutorial has been removed for being too annoying and unhelpful. 

Bug Fixes 

 Hovering over cards mid-battle will now show tooltips again. 

Thank you so much for all your support as we continue to work on BTM! We hope you enjoy these updates as much as we do and would love to hear from you over in our Discord server where you can discuss the game with other players, send us feedback or suggestions, and share your run with us!

From all of us at Feldspar, we hope you have a great holiday, and we can’t wait to share more updates with you soon.  

Happy Holidays! ☃️️
